meaning:
Zererath = "oppression"
a town or territory in Manasseh and the home of Jeroboam
same as tse.re.dah (צְרֵדָה "Zeredah" H6868)
Another name of tsa.re.tan (צָֽרְתָן "Zarethan" H6891)

elsewhere.note: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah…
